import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
p=Path.cwd();ex=['SHA256-MANIFEST.json','manifest_finalize.receipt.json','manifest_finalize.output.txt'];files=[]
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 rel=str(f.relative_to(p))
 if rel in ex or not f.is_file():continue
 b=f.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
m={'algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':ex,'reason':'Manifest excludes its own bytes and the runner receipt/output created after manifest completion. All other completed receipts, helpers, frozen-after, plans, denied outcomes, ledger, handoffs and source bytes included.'}
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(m,indent=2)+'\n',text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
print('Manifest files',len(files));print('All20 bindings',len(json.loads((p/'originals.json').read_text())));print('Frozen after13 checked zero mismatches; zero credit; no further mutations planned')
